name: deck_equip_capped_twin
description: Identity-wide deck cap (docs/loot.md §34, docs/enemies_ranking.md §4.8): the curated IRON_RING (cap 1) and its loot twin (id 164, same type/power/cost/uses/effect/battle type/rider) are one card in two rows after a capped fold. Decking the curated ring then attempting the twin refuses (identity total already at cap) -- no CARD_ADDED_TO_DECK, no lock (pool 5 covers cost 2), curated row intact. Pins that the twin cannot double-deck past max_copies through its own id.
